notes: Public transport that rides real track. Tram, metro, train and ferry journeys now follow the actual line through the actual stops instead of the road beside it: you walk to a real stop, ride the real geometry, and walk off at the far end. Built from each region's own GTFS feed — the Netherlands ships inside the app, and Berlin and Milan can be added from Settings → Public transport. Journeys allow one change, and a train trip can be fed by a tram to reach the station. Pick a mode straight from the place card: tap More and bus, tram, metro and train sit beside Walk and Drive. The ETA counts the stops, since those are most of what separates a bus from a car over the same road. Buses stay on roads on purpose — a bus drives on the road, so road directions are already right for one, and it still stops and dwells like a bus. Fixed: train and metro journeys were refused for being too far from a stop, because one 800 m walking limit was applied to every mode; a journey that can't ride track now says which of four reasons applies instead of silently using the road; and “Saved” stays said instead of reverting after two seconds as though the save had failed.
